comment: 11yo female, asymptomatic, identified as germline ETV6 p.Arg399Cys (PNT-domain missense, established pathogenic) carrier on cascade testing after her 6yo brother was diagnosed with pediatric B-ALL and a germline ETV6 variant was identified on tumor + buccal NGS. Baseline CBC: platelets 70 x10⁹/L (her THC5 carrier-baseline), MCV 96 fL (mild macrocytosis), WBC + Hb normal. Family pattern: mother heterozygous carrier (now confirmed retrospectively), maternal-grandmother deceased of acute leukemia at age 56 (presumed adult-onset MDS / AML in retrospect). Engine routes to PreventionPlan: standard = ETV6 carrier surveillance — CBC + smear q3-6mo lifelong from current age, BMA + flow cytometry + cytogenetics + myeloid NGS at any new cytopenia / persistent dysplasia / new lymphadenopathy / unexplained lymphocytosis, pediatric oncology consultation established (B-ALL is the dominant pediatric phenotype), annual bleeding-history review, cascade germline testing for younger siblings + maternal-side relatives, treatment-time plan noted (no protocol modification required if B-ALL emerges per current guidelines, but carrier status influences donor selection); alternative = intensified track with q3-month CBC + smear from current age through age 20 (peak pediatric B-ALL window), scheduled BMA + flow every 2-3 years from age 5 (already past), pre-emptive HLA-typing of sibling cohort + germline-testing of all candidates, structured pediatric-oncology + adult-hematology co-management plan with planned transition at age 18-21.
